mapper.select: SELECT cl.content_id FROM content_like cl INNER JOIN video v ON cl.content_id = v.id AND v.is_delete = 0 WHERE cl.user_id = #{userId} AND cl.is_liked = 1 ORDER BY cl.update_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content_like cl INNER JOIN video v ON cl.content_id = v.id AND v.is_delete = 0 AND v.status = 'published' AND v.visibility = 'public' WHERE cl.user_id = #{userId} AND cl.is_liked = 1
